downloadable_stories.title: The Monkey's Paw
downloadable_stories.author: W. W. Jacobs
downloadable_stories.description: An old couple receives a mysterious dried monkey's paw that can grant three wishes. Their soldier friend warns them to throw it away. They laugh — until the wishes begin to come true in ways they never imagined.

downloadable_stories.title: The Tell-Tale Heart
downloadable_stories.author: Edgar Allan Poe
downloadable_stories.description: A man insists he is not mad. Yet for seven nights he has been watching an old man sleep, obsessed with his pale, clouded eye. He has committed the perfect crime. So why does he keep hearing that sound?

downloadable_stories.title: To Build a Fire
downloadable_stories.author: Jack London
downloadable_stories.description: A confident newcomer follows a frozen Yukon creek with a wary dog, trusting his own judgment in a land of dangerous cold.
